title: Defining and Categorising Human-AI Interactions in Clinical Trials: A Multidimensional Human-AI Classification Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.38559v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper examines human-AI interactions (HAIIs) in clinical trials and presents a multidimensional categorisation framework that classifies interactions according to AI tasks, human-AI relationships, interaction configurations and interacting human groups. We define HAII, examine existing taxonomies and extend existing categorisation approaches through this novel multidimensional framework. We purposively sampled 15 clinical trials from a previously reported dataset. Each trial was independently categorised by two human reviewers and six large language model (LLM) classifiers. The proposed categorisation provides a structured method for the consistent identification, comparison and synthesis of human-AI interactions across clinical-trial records. translated_title: 定义与分类临床试验中的人机交互：一种多维人机分类方法
translated_abstract: 本文研究了临床试验中的人机交互（HAII），提出了一个多维分类框架，根据AI任务、人机关系、交互配置以及参与交互的人员群体对交互进行分类。我们定义了HAII，考察了现有的分类体系，并通过这一新颖的多维框架扩展了现有的分类方法。我们从先前报告的数据集中有目的地抽取了15项临床试验。每项试验由两名人类评审员和六个大语言模型（LLM）分类器独立进行分类。所提出的分类方法为在临床试验记录中一致地识别、比较和综合人机交互提供了一种结构化的方法。该框架旨在支持对AI相关临床试验进行更一致的比较与综合，并明确与AI干预相关的不同形式的人类参与。
tldr: 本文提出了一个从AI任务、人机关系、交互配置和参与人员群体四个维度对临床试验中人机交互进行定义和分类的多维框架，并通过两名人类评审员与六个大语言模型分类器对15项临床试验的独立分类验证了该框架的可行性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multidimensional framework for defining and categorizing human-AI interactions in clinical trials across four dimensions—AI tasks, human-AI relationships, interaction configurations, and interacting human groups—validated by independent classification of 15 trials by human reviewers and six LLM classifiers.
